+/-- Exact mass, conjugation, convergence, bound and absolute weighted exchange.
+The original owner supplies the complex mass; the occurrence transports and
+absolute exchange below introduce no analytic premise. -/
+theorem actual_complete_H_package :
+    let a : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => 1 / (actualZero k * (1 - actualZero k))
+    HasSum a (firstLiMass : ℂ) ∧
+      ∃ c : Equiv.Perm ℕ,
+        (∀ k : ℕ, actualZero (c k) = conj (actualZero k)) ∧
+        (∀ y : ℝ,
+          Summable (fun k : ℕ => a k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)) ∧
+          (∑' k : ℕ, a k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)).im = 0 ∧
+          ‖∑' k : ℕ, a k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)‖ ≤
+            ((101 / 100 : ℝ) * firstLiMass) * Real.exp (max y 0)) ∧
+        (∀ w : ℝ → ℂ, AEStronglyMeasurable w volume →
+          Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖) →
+          HasSum
+            (fun k : ℕ => a k * ∫ y : ℝ,
+              Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k) * w y)
+            (∫ y : ℝ,
+              (∑' k : ℕ, a k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)) * w y)) := by
+  classical
+  dsimp only
+  let a : ℕ → ℂ := fun k => 1 / (actualZero k * (1 - actualZero k))
+  have hweighted := actual_complex_pairWeight_hasSum
+  have hnorm : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (actualData.multiplicity n : ℝ) *
+      ‖1 / (actualData.zero n * (1 - actualData.zero n))‖) := by
+    simpa [norm_mul] using hweighted.summable.norm
+  have hSigmaNorm : Summable (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence =>
+      ‖1 / (actualData.zero p.1 * (1 - actualData.zero p.1))‖) := by
+    apply (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)).2
+    constructor
+    · intro n
+      exact Summable.of_finite
+    · simpa only [tsum_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
+        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using hnorm
+  have hSigma : Summable (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence =>
+      1 / (actualData.zero p.1 * (1 - actualData.zero p.1))) :=
+    hSigmaNorm.of_norm
+  have hSigmaMass : HasSum (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence =>
+      1 / (actualData.zero p.1 * (1 - actualData.zero p.1))) (firstLiMass : ℂ) := by
+    convert hSigma.hasSum using 1
+    rw [hSigma.tsum_sigma]
+    simpa only [tsum_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
+      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using hweighted.tsum_eq.symm
+  have hmass : HasSum a (firstLiMass : ℂ) := by
+    simpa only [Function.comp_def, a, actualZero] using
+      (actualOccurrenceEquiv.hasSum_iff).2 hSigmaMass
+  have hRSigma : Summable (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence =>
+      ((actualData.zero p.1).im)⁻¹ ^ 2) := by
+    apply (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (fun _ => sq_nonneg _)).2
+    constructor
+    · intro n
+      exact Summable.of_finite
+    · simpa only [tsum_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
+        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using actual_weighted_inverse_square_summable
+  have hR : Summable (fun k : ℕ => ((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2) := by
+    simpa only [Function.comp_def, actualZero] using
+      (actualOccurrenceEquiv.summable_iff).2 hRSigma
+  have hcoeff (k : ℕ) : ‖a k‖ ≤ ((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
+    have hheight := actual_height_gt_ten (actualZero k)
+      (actualData.zero_isNontrivial (actualOccurrenceEquiv k).1)
+    have ht : 0 < |(actualZero k).im| := by linarith
+    have ht2 : 0 < (actualZero k).im ^ 2 := by
+      have he := sq_pos_of_pos ht
+      simpa only [sq_abs] using he
+    have hp : |(actualZero k).im| ≤ ‖actualZero k‖ :=
+      Complex.abs_im_le_norm _
+    have hm : |(actualZero k).im| ≤ ‖1 - actualZero k‖ := by
+      simpa only [Complex.sub_im, Complex.one_im, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
+        Complex.abs_im_le_norm (1 - actualZero k)
+    have hprod : (actualZero k).im ^ 2 ≤ ‖actualZero k‖ * ‖1 - actualZero k‖ := by
+      calc
+        _ = |(actualZero k).im| * |(actualZero k).im| := by
+          rw [← sq_abs]
+          ring
+        _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hp hm (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
+    calc
+      ‖a k‖ = 1 / (‖actualZero k‖ * ‖1 - actualZero k‖) := by
+        simp only [a, norm_div, norm_one, norm_mul]
+      _ ≤ 1 / ((actualZero k).im ^ 2) := one_div_le_one_div_of_le ht2 hprod
+      _ = ((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2 := by simp only [one_div, inv_pow]
+  let σ : Equiv.Perm ActualZeroOccurrence :=
+    Equiv.sigmaCongr actualData.conjugation
+      (fun n => finCongr (actualData.multiplicity_conjugation n).symm)
+  let c : Equiv.Perm ℕ :=
+    actualOccurrenceEquiv.trans (σ.trans actualOccurrenceEquiv.symm)
+  have hc (k : ℕ) : actualZero (c k) = conj (actualZero k) := by
+    simp only [actualZero, c, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
+    change actualData.zero (actualData.conjugation (actualOccurrenceEquiv k).1) = _
+    exact actualData.zero_conjugation _
+  let f : ℝ → ℕ → ℂ := fun y k => a k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)
+  have hdom (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : ‖f y k‖ ≤ ‖a k‖ * Real.exp (max y 0) := by
+    have hs := (actualData.zero_isNontrivial (actualOccurrenceEquiv k).1).2
+    have hs0 : 0 ≤ (actualZero k).re := hs.1.le
+    have hs1 : (actualZero k).re ≤ 1 := hs.2.le
+    have he : y * (actualZero k).re ≤ max y 0 := by
+      rcases le_or_gt 0 y with hy | hy
+      · rw [max_eq_left hy]
+        nlinarith
+      · have hm : y * (actualZero k).re ≤ 0 :=
+          mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy.le hs0
+        simpa only [max_eq_right hy.le] using hm
+    dsimp only [f]
+    rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
+    simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im,
+      zero_mul, sub_zero]
+    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he) (norm_nonneg _)
+  have hsum (y : ℝ) : Summable (f y) :=
+    Summable.of_norm_bounded (hmass.summable.norm.mul_right (Real.exp (max y 0)))
+      (hdom y)
+  have hconj (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) : conj (f y k) = f y (c k) := by
+    simp [f, a, hc, ← Complex.exp_conj]
+  have hreal (y : ℝ) : (∑' k : ℕ, f y k).im = 0 := by
+    have he : conj (∑' k : ℕ, f y k) = ∑' k : ℕ, f y k := by
+      rw [Complex.conj_tsum]
+      simp_rw [hconj]
+      exact c.tsum_eq (f y)
+    have him := congrArg Complex.im he
+    simp only [Complex.conj_im] at him
+    linarith
+  have hbound (y : ℝ) : ‖∑' k : ℕ, f y k‖ ≤
+      ((101 / 100 : ℝ) * firstLiMass) * Real.exp (max y 0) := by
+    have hmajor : HasSum
+        (fun k : ℕ => (((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2) * Real.exp (max y 0))
+        ((∑' k : ℕ, ((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2) * Real.exp (max y 0)) :=
+      hR.hasSum.mul_right _
+    calc
+      _ ≤ (∑' k : ℕ, ((actualZero k).im)⁻¹ ^ 2) * Real.exp (max y 0) := by
+        apply tsum_of_norm_bounded hmajor
+        intro k
+        exact (hdom y k).trans
+          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcoeff k) (Real.exp_nonneg _))
+      _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right actual_inverse_square_mass_le_height
+        (Real.exp_nonneg _)
+  have hexchange (w : ℝ → ℂ) (hw : AEStronglyMeasurable w volume)
+      (hwi : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖)) :
+      HasSum
+        (fun k : ℕ => a k * ∫ y : ℝ,
+          Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k) * w y)
+        (∫ y : ℝ, (∑' k : ℕ, f y k) * w y) := by
+    let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ := fun k y => f y k * w y
+    let b : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun k y =>
+      ‖a k‖ * (Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖)
+    have hF : ∀ k : ℕ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F k) volume := by
+      intro k
+      have hcontinuous : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => f y k) := by
+        dsimp only [f]
+        fun_prop
+      exact hcontinuous.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hw
+    have hFb : ∀ k : ℕ, ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, ‖F k y‖ ≤ b k y := by
+      intro k
+      exact ae_of_all volume fun y => by
+        calc
+          _ = ‖f y k‖ * ‖w y‖ := norm_mul _ _
+          _ ≤ (‖a k‖ * Real.exp (max y 0)) * ‖w y‖ :=
+            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hdom y k) (norm_nonneg _)
+          _ = _ := by dsimp only [b]; ring
+    have hbsum : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ, Summable (fun k : ℕ => b k y) :=
+      ae_of_all volume fun y =>
+        hmass.summable.norm.mul_right (Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖)
+    have hbint : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => ∑' k : ℕ, b k y) := by
+      simpa only [b, tsum_mul_right] using
+        hwi.const_mul (∑' k : ℕ, ‖a k‖)
+    have hlim : ∀ᵐ y : ℝ,
+        HasSum (fun k : ℕ => F k y) ((∑' k : ℕ, f y k) * w y) := by
+      exact ae_of_all volume fun y => (hsum y).hasSum.mul_right (w y)
+    have hd := hasSum_integral_of_dominated_convergence b hF hFb hbsum hbint hlim
+    convert hd using 1
+    funext k
+    dsimp only [F, f]
+    simp only [mul_assoc, integral_const_mul]
+  exact ⟨hmass, c, hc, (fun y => ⟨hsum y, hreal y, hbound y⟩), hexchange⟩
+
+/-- Each natural index is an occurrence, including the analytic multiplicity. -/
+def actualCoeff (k : ℕ) : ℂ := 1 / (actualZero k * (1 - actualZero k))
+
+/-- Complete zero series on the full real axis. -/
+def actualH (y : ℝ) : ℂ :=
+  ∑' k : ℕ, actualCoeff k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)
+
+theorem actualCoeff_hasSum : HasSum actualCoeff (firstLiMass : ℂ) :=
+  actual_complete_H_package.1
+
+theorem actualH_summable (y : ℝ) :
+    Summable (fun k : ℕ => actualCoeff k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)) :=
+  actual_complete_H_package.2.choose_spec.2.1 y |>.1
+
+theorem actualH_bound (y : ℝ) :
+    ‖actualH y‖ ≤ ((101 / 100 : ℝ) * firstLiMass) * Real.exp (max y 0) :=
+  actual_complete_H_package.2.choose_spec.2.1 y |>.2.2
+
+private theorem actual_zero_strip (k : ℕ) :
+    0 < (actualZero k).re ∧ (actualZero k).re < 1 :=
+  (actualData.zero_isNontrivial (actualOccurrenceEquiv k).1).2
+
+private theorem term_bound (y : ℝ) (k : ℕ) :
+    ‖actualCoeff k * Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k)‖ ≤
+      ‖actualCoeff k‖ * Real.exp (max y 0) := by
+  obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := actual_zero_strip k
+  have he : y * (actualZero k).re ≤ max y 0 := by
+    rcases le_or_gt 0 y with hy | hy
+    · rw [max_eq_left hy]
+      nlinarith
+    · rw [max_eq_right hy.le]
+      exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg hy.le h0.le
+  rw [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
+  simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
+  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr he) (norm_nonneg _)
+
+theorem actualH_continuous : Continuous actualH := by
+  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
+  intro y
+  let u : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ‖actualCoeff k‖ * Real.exp (max (y + 1) 0)
+  have hu : Summable u := actualCoeff_hasSum.summable.norm.mul_right _
+  have hc : ContinuousOn actualH (Set.Iio (y + 1)) := by
+    apply continuousOn_tsum
+      (fun k => (show Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
+        actualCoeff k * Complex.exp ((x : ℂ) * actualZero k)) by fun_prop).continuousOn)
+      hu
+    intro k x hx
+    exact (term_bound x k).trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (max_le_max hx.le le_rfl)) (norm_nonneg _))
+  exact hc.continuousAt (isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds (by simp))
+
+/-- Finite analytic-order fibers are transported without deleting occurrences. -/
+private theorem occurrence_hasSum {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ}
+    (h : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (actualData.multiplicity n : ℂ) *
+      f (actualData.zero n)) z) :
+    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => f (actualZero k)) z := by
+  have hn : Summable (fun n : ℕ => (actualData.multiplicity n : ℝ) *
+      ‖f (actualData.zero n)‖) := by
+    simpa only [norm_mul, Complex.norm_natCast] using h.summable.norm
+  have hp : Summable (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence => ‖f (actualData.zero p.1)‖) := by
+    apply (summable_sigma_of_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)).2
+    constructor
+    · intro n
+      exact Summable.of_finite
+    · simpa only [tsum_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
+        Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using hn
+  have hs := hp.of_norm
+  have he : HasSum (fun p : ActualZeroOccurrence => f (actualData.zero p.1)) z := by
+    convert hs.hasSum using 1
+    rw [hs.tsum_sigma]
+    simpa only [tsum_fintype, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
+      Fintype.card_fin, nsmul_eq_mul] using h.tsum_eq.symm
+  simpa only [Function.comp_def, actualZero] using
+    (actualOccurrenceEquiv.hasSum_iff).2 he
+
+theorem xiReading_ne_zero_right {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) : xiReading s ≠ 0 := by
+  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hs; norm_num at hs
+  have hs1 : s ≠ 1 := by intro h; rw [h] at hs; norm_num at hs
+  rw [xi_reading_eq_completed_zeta hs0 hs1, completedZetaReading,
+    (Zeta23.WeilEF.completedZeta_eventuallyEq_mul (by linarith : 0 < s.re)).eq_of_nhds]
+  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) hs0)
+    (sub_ne_zero.mpr hs1)) (mul_ne_zero
+      (Complex.Gammaℝ_ne_zero_of_re_pos (by linarith))
+      (riemannZeta_ne_zero_of_one_lt_re hs))
+
+/-- The normalized, convergent resolvent is never split into reciprocal-zero sums. -/
+theorem actual_normalized_resolvent {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
+    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => 1 / (s - actualZero k) + 1 / actualZero k)
+      (logDeriv xiReading s + (firstLiMass : ℂ) / 2) := by
+  have h := occurrence_hasSum (f := fun z : ℂ => 1 / (s - z) + 1 / z)
+    (xi_reading_normalized_resolvent_hasSum actualData s (xiReading_ne_zero_right hs))
+  rw [zero_endpoint_logDeriv] at h
+  push_cast at h
+  simpa only [neg_div, sub_neg_eq_add] using h
+
+/-- Exact bridge from the actual normalized resolvent to the integrated coefficients. -/
+theorem actual_resolvent_hasSum {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
+    HasSum (fun k : ℕ => actualCoeff k / (s - actualZero k))
+      (((firstLiMass : ℂ) * (s - 1 / 2) - logDeriv xiReading s) / (s * (s - 1))) := by
+  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro h; rw [h] at hs; norm_num at hs
+  have hs1 : s - 1 ≠ 0 := by intro h; have := congrArg Complex.re h; simp at this; linarith
+  have h := ((actualCoeff_hasSum.mul_left s).sub
+    (actual_normalized_resolvent hs)).mul_right (s * (s - 1))⁻¹
+  convert h using 1
+  · funext k
+    obtain ⟨h0, h1⟩ := actual_zero_strip k
+    have hr0 : actualZero k ≠ 0 := by intro e; simpa [e] using h0
+    have hr1 : 1 - actualZero k ≠ 0 := by
+      intro e
+      have := congrArg Complex.re e
+      simp at this
+      linarith
+    have hsr : s - actualZero k ≠ 0 := by
+      intro e
+      have := congrArg Complex.re e
+      simp at this
+      linarith
+    dsimp only [actualCoeff]
+    field_simp [hr0, hr1, hsr, hs0, hs1]
+    <;> ring
+  · ring
+
+/-- Genuine half-line norm integrability from the actual strip and absolute mass. -/
+theorem actualH_laplace_integrable {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
+    IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-s * y) * actualH y) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
+  have hb : IntegrableOn (fun y : ℝ =>
+      ((101 / 100 : ℝ) * firstLiMass) * Real.exp ((1 - s.re) * y)) (Set.Ioi 0) :=
+    (integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1 - s.re < 0) 0).const_mul _
+  refine hb.mono' (by
+    exact ((show Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-s * y)) by fun_prop).mul
+      actualH_continuous).aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
+  filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with y hy
+  calc
+    ‖Complex.exp (-s * y) * actualH y‖ = Real.exp (-s.re * y) * ‖actualH y‖ := by
+      simp [norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp]
+    _ ≤ Real.exp (-s.re * y) *
+        (((101 / 100 : ℝ) * firstLiMass) * Real.exp y) := by
+      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
+        (by simpa only [max_eq_left (le_of_lt (show 0 < y from hy))] using actualH_bound y) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
+    _ = _ := by rw [mul_left_comm, ← Real.exp_add]; congr 2 <;> ring
+
+/-- Exact Laplace identity for the complete actual occurrence family. The weighted
+exchange is the proved absolute dominated-convergence statement in the package. -/
+theorem actualH_laplace {s : ℂ} (hs : 1 < s.re) :
+    (∫ y : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-s * y) * actualH y) =
+      (((firstLiMass : ℂ) * (s - 1 / 2) - logDeriv xiReading s) / (s * (s - 1))) := by
+  classical
+  let w : ℝ → ℂ := (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun y => Complex.exp (-s * y))
+  have hw : AEStronglyMeasurable w volume :=
+    (show Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-s * y)) by fun_prop).aestronglyMeasurable
+      |>.indicator measurableSet_Ioi
+  have hwi : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖) := by
+    have he : (fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (max y 0) * ‖w y‖) =
+        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun y => Real.exp ((1 - s.re) * y)) := by
+      funext y
+      by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)
+      · simp only [w, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, max_eq_left (le_of_lt (show 0 < y from hy)), Complex.norm_exp]
+        simp only [Complex.mul_re, Complex.neg_re, Complex.ofReal_re,
+          Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, sub_zero]
+        rw [← Real.exp_add]
+        congr 1
+        ring
+      · simp only [w, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, norm_zero, mul_zero]
+    rw [he, integrable_indicator_iff measurableSet_Ioi]
+    exact integrableOn_exp_mul_Ioi (by linarith : 1 - s.re < 0) 0
+  have hx := actual_complete_H_package.2.choose_spec.2.2 w hw hwi
+  have hterm (k : ℕ) :
+      (∫ y : ℝ, Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k) * w y) =
+        1 / (s - actualZero k) := by
+    have he : (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp ((y : ℂ) * actualZero k) * w y) =
+        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator
+          (fun y => Complex.exp ((actualZero k - s) * y)) := by
+      funext y
+      by_cases hy : y ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)
+      · simp only [w, Set.indicator_of_mem hy, ← Complex.exp_add]
+        congr 1
+        ring
+      · simp only [w, Set.indicator_of_notMem hy, mul_zero]
+    rw [he, integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi,
+      integral_exp_mul_complex_Ioi (by
+        simp only [Complex.sub_re]
+        linarith [(actual_zero_strip k).2])]
+    simp only [Complex.ofReal_zero, mul_zero, Complex.exp_zero]
+    rw [show actualZero k - s = -(s - actualZero k) by ring, div_neg]
+    simp only [neg_neg, neg_div, one_div]
+  have htotal : (∫ y : ℝ, actualH y * w y) =
+      ∫ y : ℝ in Set.Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-s * y) * actualH y := by
+    have he : (fun y : ℝ => actualH y * w y) =
+        (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)).indicator (fun y => Complex.exp (-s * y) * actualH y) := by
+      funext y

+private theorem line_half_integerComplement {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
+    transformLine t / 2 ∈ Complex.integerComplement := by
+  rintro ⟨n, hn⟩

+    simp [transformLine, div_eq_mul_inv] <;> ring
+  have he := congrArg Complex.im hn

+/-- Digamma, coefficient mass and the complete correction are combined only
+as absolutely convergent HasSum statements. -/
+private theorem digamma_trivial_balance {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≠ 0) :
+    (Complex.digamma (transformLine t / 2) / 2 +
+        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) / 2 + 1 / transformLine t) /
+          transformLine t +
+      (transformLine t - 1) *
+        (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-transformLine t * y) * (trivialT y : ℂ)) =
+      (1 - Real.log 2 : ℝ) := by

+  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by intro e; have := congrArg Complex.re e; simp [s] at this
+  have hA : HasSum (fun n : ℕ =>
+      1 / (2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) * (s + 2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1))))
+      ((Complex.digamma (s / 2) / 2 +
+        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) / 2 + 1 / s) / s) := by
+    have hdig : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => 1 / ((n : ℂ) + 1) - 1 / (s / 2 + n + 1))

+      Zeta23.DigammaSeries.hasSum_digamma_series (line_half_integerComplement ht)
+    convert hdig.mul_right (1 / (2 * s)) using 1
+    · funext n
+      have hj : ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero n
+      have hsj : s + 2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1) ≠ 0 := by
+        intro e
+        have := congrArg Complex.re e
+        simp [s] at this
+        linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
+      rw [show s / 2 + (n : ℂ) + 1 = (s + 2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1)) / 2 by ring,
+        one_div_div]
+      field_simp [hj, hsj, hs0]
+      <;> ring
+    · field_simp [hs0]
+      <;> ring
+  have hR : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (trivialCoeff n : ℂ) / (s + 2 * ((n : ℂ) + 1)))
+      (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0, Complex.exp (-s * y) * (trivialT y : ℂ)) :=
+    trivialT_laplace_hasSum (by simp [s] : 0 < s.re)
+  have hc : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (trivialCoeff n : ℂ))
+      ((Complex.digamma (s / 2) / 2 +
+        (Real.eulerMascheroniConstant : ℂ) / 2 + 1 / s) / s +
+        (s - 1) * (∫ y : ℝ in Ioi 0,
+          Complex.exp (-s * y) * (trivialT y : ℂ))) := by
+    convert hA.add (hR.mul_left (s - 1)) using 1
+    funext n
+    let j : ℂ := (n : ℂ) + 1
+    have hj : j ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_add_one_ne_zero n
+    have hj1 : 2 * j + 1 ≠ 0 := by
+      intro e
+      have := congrArg Complex.re e
+      dsimp only [j] at this
+      simp at this
+      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
+    have hsj : s + 2 * j ≠ 0 := by
+      intro e
+      have := congrArg Complex.re e
+      simp [s, j] at this
+      linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
+    have hcj : (trivialCoeff n : ℂ) = 1 / (2 * j * (2 * j + 1)) := by
+      simp [trivialCoeff, j]
+    rw [hcj]
+    calc
+      1 / (2 * j * (2 * j + 1)) =
+          1 / (2 * j * (s + 2 * j)) +
+            (s - 1) / (2 * j * (2 * j + 1) * (s + 2 * j)) :=
+        (trivial_partial_fraction j s hj hj1 hsj).symm
+      _ = _ := by
+        change 1 / (2 * j * (s + 2 * j)) +
+          (s - 1) / (2 * j * (2 * j + 1) * (s + 2 * j)) =
+          1 / (2 * j * (s + 2 * j)) +
+            (s - 1) * (1 / (2 * j * (2 * j + 1)) / (s + 2 * j))

+def bandPiece (f : LineL2) (R : ℝ) : LineL2 :=
+  (bandMemLp f R).toLp ((cyclesBand R).indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ))
+def bandNorm (f : LineL2) (R : ℝ) : ℝ := ‖bandPiece f R‖
+private lemma sourceEnergy_integrable (u : LineL2) :
+    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖u x‖ ^ 2) volume := by
+  exact (Lp.memLp u).integrable_norm_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)
+private lemma compact_memLp_one (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
+    MemLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)) 1 volume := by
+  have h2 : MemLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)) 2 volume :=
+    (Lp.memLp u).indicator measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet
+  apply h2.mono_exponent_of_measure_support_ne_top
+      (s := Icc (0 : ℝ) r) (hpq := by norm_num)
+  · intro x hx
+    simp [Set.indicator, hx]
+  · simp [Real.volume_Icc, hr]
+private lemma compact_memLp_two (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) :
+    MemLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)) 2 volume :=
+  (Lp.memLp u).indicator measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet
+private def compactPiece (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) : LineL2 :=
+  (compact_memLp_two u hr).toLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ))
+/-- The compact piece has the raw Fourier L∞ bound obtained from L2 Hölder.
+The full source is never required to be L1. -/
+theorem compact_fourier_Linf_bound (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
+    ∀ w : ℝ,
+      ‖𝓕 ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)) w‖ ≤
+        Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) := by
+  let v : ℝ → ℂ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)
+  have hv2 : MemLp v 2 volume :=
+    (Lp.memLp u).indicator measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet
+  have hv1 : MemLp v 1 volume := compact_memLp_one u hr.le
+  have hconst : MemLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)))
+      2 volume := by
+    exact memLp_indicator_const 2 measurableSet_Icc.nullMeasurableSet
+      (1 : ℂ) (Or.inr (by simp [Real.volume_Icc, hr.le]))
+  have hsource : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖u x‖ ^ 2) volume :=
+    sourceEnergy_integrable u
+  have hvnorm : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖v x‖ ^ 2) volume :=
+    hv2.integrable_norm_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)
+  have hfirst : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖v x‖ ^ 2) ≤ sourceEnergy u := by
+    apply integral_mono_ae hvnorm hsource
+    filter_upwards with x
+    by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) r
+    · simp only [v, Set.indicator_of_mem hx]
+      exact le_rfl
+    · simp [v, hx]
+  have hsecond :
+      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) = r := by
+    have hcongr :
+        (fun x : ℝ => ‖(Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) =
+          (Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ)) := by
+      funext x
+      by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) r <;> simp [hx]
+    rw [hcongr, integral_indicator_const (1 : ℝ) measurableSet_Icc]
+    simp [Real.volume_Icc, hr.le]
+  have hholder := integral_mul_norm_le_Lp_mul_Lq
+    (p := (2 : ℝ)) (q := (2 : ℝ))
+      (by norm_num [Real.holderConjugate_iff] : Real.HolderConjugate 2 2)
+    (show MemLp v (ENNReal.ofReal 2) volume by simpa using hv2)
+    (show MemLp ((Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)))
+        (ENNReal.ofReal 2) volume by simpa using hconst)
+  intro w
+  have hfirst' : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖v x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ≤ sourceEnergy u := by
+    simpa [Real.rpow_two] using hfirst
+  have hS : 0 ≤ sourceEnergy u := integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
+  have hprod :
+      (fun x : ℝ => ‖v x‖ *
+        ‖(Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) x‖) =
+        (fun x : ℝ => ‖v x‖) := by
+    funext x
+    by_cases hx : x ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) r <;> simp [v, hx]
+  calc
+    ‖𝓕 v w‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖v x‖ := Real.norm_fourier_le_integral_norm v w
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖v x‖ *
+        ‖(Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) x‖ := by rw [hprod]
+    _ ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, ‖v x‖ ^ (2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2) *
+        (∫ x : ℝ, ‖(Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (1 : ℂ)) x‖ ^
+          (2 : ℝ)) ^ (1 / 2) := hholder
+    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) * Real.sqrt r := by
+      rw [hsecond]
+      rw [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow]
+      exact mul_le_mul
+        (Real.rpow_le_rpow (by positivity) hfirst' (by norm_num)) le_rfl
+        (by positivity) (Real.rpow_nonneg hS _)
+    _ = Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) := by ring
+theorem source_energy_nonnegative (u : LineL2) : 0 ≤ sourceEnergy u := by
+  exact integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _
+theorem first_position_moment_nonnegative (u : LineL2)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0) :
+    0 ≤ firstPositionMoment u := by
+  refine integral_nonneg_of_ae ?_
+  filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
+  exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (mem_Ioi.mp hx)) (sq_nonneg _)
+private lemma band_norm_le_of_ae_norm_le (f g : LineL2) {R A : ℝ}
+    (hR : 0 < R) (hA : 0 ≤ A)
+    (hpoint : ∀ᵐ w : ℝ ∂volume,
+      w ∈ cyclesBand R → ‖f w‖ ≤ A + ‖g w‖) :
+    bandNorm f R ≤ A * Real.sqrt (2 * R) + bandNorm g R := by
+  let s : Set ℝ := cyclesBand R
+  have hs : MeasurableSet s := measurableSet_Ioo
+  have hs_top : volume s ≠ ∞ := by
+    simp [s, cyclesBand, Real.volume_Ioo, hR.le]
+  have hf : MemLp (s.indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ)) 2 volume :=
+    bandMemLp f R
+  have hg : MemLp (s.indicator (g : ℝ → ℂ)) 2 volume :=
+    bandMemLp g R
+  have hA_mem : MemLp (s.indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (A : ℝ))) 2 volume :=
+    memLp_indicator_const 2 hs.nullMeasurableSet A (Or.inr hs_top)
+  have hgn_mem : MemLp (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖)) 2 volume :=
+    by simpa only [norm_indicator_eq_indicator_norm] using hg.norm
+  have hsum_mem := hA_mem.add hgn_mem
+  let bound : RealL2 := hsum_mem.toLp
+    (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => A) + s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))
+  have hbound_eq :
+      s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => A) + s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖) =
+        s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => A + ‖g x‖) := by
+    funext x
+    by_cases hx : x ∈ s <;> simp [hx, add_comm]
+  have hbound_coe :
+      bound =ᵐ[volume] s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => A + ‖g x‖) := by
+    simpa [bound, hbound_eq] using hsum_mem.coeFn_toLp
+  have hf_coe : (bandPiece f R : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      s.indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ) := (bandMemLp f R).coeFn_toLp
+  have hpoint' : ∀ᵐ w : ℝ ∂volume,
+      ‖bandPiece f R w‖ ≤ ‖bound w‖ := by
+    filter_upwards [hf_coe, hbound_coe, hpoint] with w hwf hwb hw
+    rw [hwf, hwb]
+    by_cases hws : w ∈ s
+    · simp only [Set.indicator_of_mem hws]
+      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (add_nonneg hA (norm_nonneg _))] using hw hws
+    · simp [hws]
+  have hnorm : bandNorm f R ≤ ‖bound‖ :=
+    Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le hpoint'
+  have hA_norm :
+      ‖hA_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (A : ℝ)))‖ =
+        A * Real.sqrt (2 * R) := by
+    change ‖indicatorConstLp (μ := volume) 2 hs hs_top A‖ = _
+    rw [norm_indicatorConstLp (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
+    have htwo : R + R = 2 * R := by ring
+    simp [s, cyclesBand, Real.volume_Ioo, hR.le, Real.sqrt_eq_rpow,
+      abs_of_nonneg hA, htwo]
+  have hgn_norm :
+      ‖hgn_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))‖ = bandNorm g R := by
+    change ‖hgn_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))‖ =
+      ‖(bandMemLp g R).toLp ((cyclesBand R).indicator (g : ℝ → ℂ))‖
+    rw [Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_toLp]
+    simpa only [norm_indicator_eq_indicator_norm, s] using congrArg ENNReal.toReal
+      (eLpNorm_norm _ hg.aestronglyMeasurable)
+  calc
+    bandNorm f R ≤ ‖bound‖ := hnorm
+    _ = ‖hA_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (A : ℝ))) +
+        hgn_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))‖ := by
+      change ‖hsum_mem.toLp
+        (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => A) + s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))‖ = _
+      rw [MemLp.toLp_add]
+    _ ≤ ‖hA_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun _ : ℝ => (A : ℝ)))‖ +
+        ‖hgn_mem.toLp (s.indicator (fun x : ℝ => ‖g x‖))‖ := norm_add_le _ _
+    _ = A * Real.sqrt (2 * R) + bandNorm g R := by rw [hA_norm, hgn_norm]
+/- The first-moment tail payment is proved before any Fourier statement.  This
+   is the exact place where the support half-line and the factor `1 / r` enter.
+   The theorem is an ordinary set-integral estimate and does not assume that
+   the full source is integrable in L1. -/
+theorem tail_position_energy_le (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) ≤ firstPositionMoment u / r := by
+  have hU : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi r)) :=
+    (sourceEnergy_integrable u).integrableOn
+  have hM_r : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi r)) := by
+    apply hMoment.mono_measure
+    exact Measure.restrict_mono_set volume (show Ioi r ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) from
+      fun x hx => lt_trans hr hx)
+  have hscaled : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (1 / r) * (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2))
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi r)) := hM_r.const_mul _
+  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi r)),
+      ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / r) * (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := by
+    filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
+    have hx' : r ≤ x := le_of_lt (mem_Ioi.mp hx)
+    have hn : 0 ≤ ‖u x‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
+    calc
+      ‖u x‖ ^ 2 ≤ (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) / r := by
+        apply (le_div_iff₀ hr).2
+        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hx') hn]
+      _ = (1 / r) * (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := by ring
+  have hlocal : (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) ≤
+      ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, (1 / r) * (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) :=
+    integral_mono_ae hU hscaled hpoint
+  calc
+    (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) ≤
+        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, (1 / r) * (x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := hlocal
+    _ = (1 / r) * (∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := by
+      rw [integral_const_mul]
+    _ ≤ (1 / r) * firstPositionMoment u := by
+      gcongr
+      apply integral_mono_measure
+        (μ := volume.restrict (Ioi r))
+        (ν := volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))
+      · exact Measure.restrict_mono_set volume (show Ioi r ⊆ Ioi (0 : ℝ) from
+          fun x hx => lt_trans hr hx)
+      · filter_upwards [self_mem_ae_restrict measurableSet_Ioi] with x hx
+        exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (mem_Ioi.mp hx)) (sq_nonneg _)
+      · exact hMoment
+    _ = firstPositionMoment u / r := by ring
+theorem compact_remainder_norm_le (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    ‖u - compactPiece u hr.le‖ ≤
+      Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+  let tail : LineL2 := u - compactPiece u hr.le
+  have htail_ae : (tail : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      (Ioi r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ) := by
+    have hu : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0 := hSupport
+    have hc : (compactPiece u hr.le : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+        (Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ) := by
+      exact (compact_memLp_two u hr.le).coeFn_toLp
+    filter_upwards [hu, hc, Lp.coeFn_sub u (compactPiece u hr.le)] with x hxneg hxc htail
+    by_cases hx0 : x < 0
+    · have hux : u x = 0 := hxneg hx0
+      rw [htail]
+      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
+      rw [hux]
+      have hnot : ¬ x ∈ Ioi r := by
+        exact not_lt_of_ge (le_trans (le_of_lt hx0) hr.le)
+      have hnotmem : x ∉ Icc (0 : ℝ) r := by
+        exact fun hx => (not_lt_of_ge hx.1) hx0
+      rw [hxc]
+      simp [hnot, hnotmem]
+    by_cases hxr : x ≤ r
+    · have hxc' : (compactPiece u hr.le : ℝ → ℂ) x = u x := by
+        rw [hxc]
+        simp [le_of_not_gt hx0, hxr]
+      rw [htail]
+      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
+      rw [hxc']
+      simp [hxr]
+    · have hxc' : (compactPiece u hr.le : ℝ → ℂ) x = 0 := by
+        rw [hxc]
+        have hnotmem : x ∉ Icc (0 : ℝ) r := by
+          exact fun hx => hxr hx.2
+        simp [hnotmem]
+      rw [htail]
+      simp only [Pi.sub_apply]
+      rw [hxc']
+      have hri : r < x := lt_of_not_ge hxr
+      simp [hri]
+  have htail_norm_eq :
+      ‖tail‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, ‖tail x‖ ^ 2) := by
+    rw [Lp.norm_def]
+    change lpNorm (tail : ℝ → ℂ) 2 volume = _
+    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal
+      (f := (tail : ℝ → ℂ))
+      (μ := volume)
+      (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))
+      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
+      ((Lp.memLp tail).aestronglyMeasurable)]
+    norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_two]
+  have htail_int_eq :
+      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖tail x‖ ^ 2) =
+        ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, ‖u x‖ ^ 2 := by
+    calc
+      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖tail x‖ ^ 2) =
+          ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(Ioi r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ) x‖ ^ 2 := by
+            apply integral_congr_ae
+            filter_upwards [htail_ae] with x hx
+            rw [hx]
+      _ = ∫ x : ℝ in Ioi r, ‖u x‖ ^ 2 := by
+        rw [← integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioi]
+        apply integral_congr_ae
+        filter_upwards with x
+        by_cases hx : x ∈ Ioi r <;> simp [hx]
+  have htail_le :
+      (∫ x : ℝ, ‖tail x‖ ^ 2) ≤ firstPositionMoment u / r := by
+    rw [htail_int_eq]
+    exact tail_position_energy_le u hr hMoment
+  change ‖tail‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r)
+  rw [htail_norm_eq]
+  exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt htail_le
+private theorem band_norm_le_norm (f : LineL2) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
+    bandNorm f R ≤ ‖f‖ := by
+  have hcoe : (bandPiece f R : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      (cyclesBand R).indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ) :=
+    (bandMemLp f R).coeFn_toLp
+  apply Lp.norm_le_norm_of_ae_le
+  filter_upwards [hcoe] with w hw
+  rw [hw]
+  by_cases hwr : w ∈ cyclesBand R <;> simp [hwr]
+private theorem compact_fourier_lp_ae_bound (u : LineL2) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
+    ∀ᵐ w : ℝ ∂volume,
+      ‖𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) w‖ ≤
+        Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) := by
+  let v : ℝ → ℂ := (Icc (0 : ℝ) r).indicator (u : ℝ → ℂ)
+  have hv1 : Integrable v := by
+    apply memLp_one_iff_integrable.mp
+    simpa [v] using (compact_memLp_one u hr.le)
+  have hv2 : MemLp v 2 volume := by
+    simpa [v] using (compact_memLp_two u hr.le)
+  have hraw := LineFourier.raw_fourier_ae_eq_L2 hv1 hv2
+  have hraw' : ((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume] 𝓕 v := by
+    simpa [compactPiece, v] using hraw.symm
+  filter_upwards [hraw'] with w hw
+  rw [hw]
+  exact compact_fourier_Linf_bound u hr w
+theorem fourier_band_bound (u : LineL2) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+  let tail : LineL2 := u - compactPiece u hr.le
+  have hu : u = compactPiece u hr.le + tail := by
+    dsimp [tail]
+    abel
+  have hFourier : (𝓕 u : LineL2) =
+      (𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) + (𝓕 tail : LineL2) := by
+    calc
+      (𝓕 u : LineL2) = 𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le + tail) := congrArg 𝓕 hu
+      _ = (𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) + (𝓕 tail : LineL2) := by
+        change (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) (compactPiece u hr.le + tail) =
+          (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) (compactPiece u hr.le) +
+            (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ) tail
+        exact (Lp.fourierTransformₗᵢ ℝ ℂ).map_add _ _
+  have hdecomp : ((𝓕 u : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]
+      ((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) +
+        ((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) := by
+    rw [hFourier]
+    exact Lp.coeFn_add _ _
+  have hcompact := compact_fourier_lp_ae_bound u hr
+  have hA : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) :=
+    mul_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
+  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ w : ℝ ∂volume,
+      w ∈ cyclesBand R →
+        ‖((𝓕 u : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ ≤
+          Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) +
+            ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := by
+    filter_upwards [hdecomp, hcompact] with w hw hc
+    intro hwband
+    rw [hw]
+    calc
+      ‖((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w +
+          ((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ ≤
+          ‖((𝓕 (compactPiece u hr.le) : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ +
+            ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
+      _ ≤ Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u) +
+          ‖((𝓕 tail : LineL2) : ℝ → ℂ) w‖ := by gcongr
+  have htail : bandNorm (𝓕 tail : LineL2) R ≤
+      Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+    calc
+      bandNorm (𝓕 tail : LineL2) R ≤ ‖𝓕 tail‖ := band_norm_le_norm _ hR
+      _ = ‖tail‖ := by rw [Lp.norm_fourier_eq]
+      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+        exact compact_remainder_norm_le u hr hSupport hMoment
+  calc
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+        (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+          bandNorm (𝓕 tail) R :=
+      band_norm_le_of_ae_norm_le _ _ hR hA hpoint
+    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by gcongr
+theorem fourier_band_bound_exact (u : LineL2) {r R : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ)))) :
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by
+  have hbase := fourier_band_bound u hr hR hSupport hMoment
+  have hS : 0 ≤ sourceEnergy u := source_energy_nonnegative u
+  have hroot :
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) =
+        Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) := by
+    calc
+      (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) =
+          Real.sqrt (r * sourceEnergy u) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) := by
+            rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hr.le]
+      _ = Real.sqrt ((r * sourceEnergy u) * (2 * R)) := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_mul (mul_nonneg hr.le hS)]
+      _ = Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) := by
+            congr 1 <;> ring
+  calc
+    bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+        (Real.sqrt r * Real.sqrt (sourceEnergy u)) * Real.sqrt (2 * R) +
+          Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := hbase
+    _ = Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+          Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by rw [hroot]
+def bandMass (f : LineL2) (R : ℝ) : ℝ := (bandNorm f R) ^ 2
+private lemma sq_add_le_two_sq (a b : ℝ) :
+    (a + b) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * a ^ 2 + 2 * b ^ 2 := by
+  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b)]
+private lemma optimized_root_sum_sq {S m R r : ℝ}
+    (hS : 0 < S) (hm : 0 < m) (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hr : r = Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S))) :
+    (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S) + Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S := by
+  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
+    rw [hr]
+    positivity
+  have hratio : 0 ≤ m / (2 * R * S) := by positivity
+  have hr2 : r ^ 2 = m / (2 * R * S) := by
+    calc
+      r ^ 2 = (Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S))) ^ 2 := by rw [hr]
+      _ = m / (2 * R * S) := Real.sq_sqrt hratio
+  have hfirst : (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S)) ^ 2 = 2 * R * r * S := by
+    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
+    positivity
+  have hsecond : (Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 = m / r := by
+    rw [Real.sq_sqrt]
+    positivity
+  have hqr : Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * r = m / S := by
+    rw [hr]
+    calc
+      Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * Real.sqrt (m / (2 * R * S)) =
+          Real.sqrt ((2 * R * m / S) * (m / (2 * R * S))) := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_mul' _ hratio]
+      _ = Real.sqrt ((m / S) ^ 2) := by
+            congr 1
+            field_simp
+      _ = m / S := by
+            rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
+  have hqrS : Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * r * S = m := by
+    rw [hqr]
+    field_simp
+  have hqrS' : Real.sqrt (R * 2 * m / S) * r * S = m := by
+    rw [show R * 2 * m / S = 2 * R * m / S by ring]
+    exact hqrS
+  have hr2' : 2 * R * S * r ^ 2 = m := by
+    rw [hr2]
+    field_simp
+  calc
+    (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S) + Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 ≤
+        2 * (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * S)) ^ 2 +
+          2 * (Real.sqrt (m / r)) ^ 2 :=
+      sq_add_le_two_sq _ _
+    _ = 4 * R * r * S + 2 * m / r := by rw [hfirst, hsecond]; ring
+    _ = 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S := by
+      field_simp [ne_of_gt hrpos]
+      nlinarith [hr2', hqrS']
+theorem fourier_band_mass_ratio (u : LineL2) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
+    (hSupport : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, x < 0 → u x = 0)
+    (hMoment : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => x * ‖u x‖ ^ 2)
+      (volume.restrict (Ioi (0 : ℝ))))
+    (hS : 0 < sourceEnergy u)
+    (hm : 0 < firstPositionMoment u) :
+    bandMass (𝓕 u : LineL2) R / sourceEnergy u ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) := by
+  let r : ℝ := Real.sqrt
+    (firstPositionMoment u / (2 * R * sourceEnergy u))
+  have hr : 0 < r := by
+    dsimp [r]
+    positivity
+  have hbound := fourier_band_bound_exact u hr hR hSupport hMoment
+  have hsum : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+      Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r) := by positivity
+  have hnorm : 0 ≤ bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R := norm_nonneg _
+  have hsq : bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ^ 2 ≤
+      (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+        Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r)) ^ 2 := by
+    nlinarith
+  have hopt := optimized_root_sum_sq
+    (S := sourceEnergy u) (m := firstPositionMoment u) (R := R) (r := r)
+    hS hm hR (by rfl)
+  have hmass : bandMass (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ≤
+      4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) *
+        sourceEnergy u := by
+    unfold bandMass
+    calc
+      bandNorm (𝓕 u : LineL2) R ^ 2 ≤
+          (Real.sqrt (2 * R * r * sourceEnergy u) +
+            Real.sqrt (firstPositionMoment u / r)) ^ 2 := hsq
+      _ ≤ 4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * firstPositionMoment u / sourceEnergy u) *
+          sourceEnergy u := by
+        simpa using hopt
+  apply (div_le_iff₀ hS).2
+  simpa [mul_comm] using hmass
+/-- Signed logarithmic integration after the nonnegative layer-cake payment.
+The two integrability hypotheses are deliberately explicit: the negative part
+must be established by the layer-cake argument, while the positive part is the
+actual form-domain supplier on the Gamma source path. -/
+theorem signed_log_lower_bound_of_layer_cake
+    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {S A : ℝ}
+    (hA : 0 < A)
+    (hMassInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hMass : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = S)
+    (hLogInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hNegInt : Integrable
+      (fun x : ℝ => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hNegBound : (∫ x : ℝ,
+      max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * S) :
+    S * (Real.log A - 2) ≤
+      ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * q x
+  let c : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => Real.log A * q x
+  have hq_nonneg : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, 0 ≤ q x :=
+    Eventually.of_forall (fun x => sq_nonneg _)
+  have hq_int : Integrable q volume := by simpa [q] using hMassInt
+  have hg_int : Integrable g volume := by simpa [g, q] using hNegInt
+  have hc_int : Integrable c volume := by
+    simpa [c] using hq_int.const_mul (Real.log A)
+  have hsub_int : Integrable (fun x => c x - g x) volume := hc_int.sub hg_int
+  have hpoint : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
+      c x - g x ≤ Real.log |x| * q x := by
+    filter_upwards [Measure.ae_ne volume (0 : ℝ), hq_nonneg] with x hx0 hqx
+    have hxabs : 0 < |x| := abs_pos.mpr hx0
+    have hlog : Real.log |x| = Real.log A - Real.log (A / |x|) := by
+      rw [Real.log_div (ne_of_gt hA) (ne_of_gt hxabs)]
+      ring
+    dsimp [c, g, q]
+    rw [hlog]
+    have hmax : Real.log (A / |x|) ≤ max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 :=
+      le_max_left _ _
+    nlinarith
+  have hmono : (∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x) ≤
+      ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * q x :=
+    integral_mono_ae hsub_int (by simpa [q] using hLogInt) hpoint
+  have hsub_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x) =
+      Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := by
+    rw [integral_sub hc_int hg_int, integral_const_mul, hMass]
+  have hneg : Real.log A * S - 2 * S ≤
+      Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := by
+    dsimp [g, q] at hNegBound ⊢
+    linarith
+  calc
+    S * (Real.log A - 2) = Real.log A * S - 2 * S := by ring
+    _ ≤ Real.log A * S - ∫ x : ℝ, g x := hneg
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, c x - g x := hsub_eq.symm
+    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * q x := hmono
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, Real.log |x| * ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by rfl
+def angularUnitary (f : ℝ → ℂ) (ξ : ℝ) : ℂ :=
+  (Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi))⁻¹ * f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))
+theorem angular_unitary_mass_preserved {f : ℝ → ℂ}
+    (hInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume) :
+    (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖angularUnitary f ξ‖ ^ 2) =
+      ∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hπ : 0 < (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) := by positivity
+  have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hπ
+  have hcongr : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖angularUnitary f ξ‖ ^ 2) =
+      (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
+        ‖f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))‖ ^ 2) := by
+    funext ξ
+    simp only [angularUnitary, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, abs_of_pos hsqrt]
+    have hsqrt_norm : ‖Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi)‖ = Real.sqrt (2 * Real.pi) :=
+      abs_of_pos hsqrt
+    rw [hsqrt_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hπ.le]
+    ring
+  rw [hcongr, integral_const_mul]
+  change (1 / (2 * Real.pi)) *
+      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖f (ξ / (2 * Real.pi))‖ ^ 2) = _
+  have hcomp := MeasureTheory.Measure.integral_comp_div
+    (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) (2 * Real.pi)
+  rw [hcomp]
+  rw [abs_of_pos hπ]
+  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
+  field_simp
+private theorem lp_mass_eq_norm_sq (u : LineL2) :
+    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hnorm : ‖u‖ = Real.sqrt (∫ x : ℝ, ‖u x‖ ^ 2) := by
+    rw [Lp.norm_def]
+    change lpNorm (u : ℝ → ℂ) 2 volume = _
+    rw [lpNorm_eq_integral_norm_rpow_toReal
+      (f := (u : ℝ → ℂ))
+      (μ := volume)
+      (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))
+      (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
+      ((Lp.memLp u).aestronglyMeasurable)]
+    norm_num [Real.sqrt_eq_rpow, Real.rpow_two]
+  rw [hnorm]
+  exact (Real.sq_sqrt (integral_nonneg fun _ => sq_nonneg _)).symm
+private theorem source_energy_eq_norm_sq (u : LineL2) :
+    sourceEnergy u = ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
+  exact lp_mass_eq_norm_sq u
+private theorem bandMass_eq_setIntegral (f : LineL2) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) :
+    bandMass f R = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+  have hnorm : ‖bandPiece f R‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖bandPiece f R x‖ ^ 2 := by
+    rw [lp_mass_eq_norm_sq]
+  have hcoe : (bandPiece f R : ℝ → ℂ) =ᵐ[volume]

+    (bandMemLp f R).coeFn_toLp
+  change ‖bandPiece f R‖ ^ 2 = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  rw [hnorm]
+  calc
+    (∫ x : ℝ, ‖bandPiece f R x‖ ^ 2) =
+        ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(cyclesBand R).indicator (f : ℝ → ℂ) x‖ ^ 2 := by
+      apply integral_congr_ae
+      filter_upwards [hcoe] with x hx
+      rw [hx]
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, (cyclesBand R).indicator (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) x := by
+      apply integral_congr_ae
+      filter_upwards with x
+      by_cases hx : x ∈ cyclesBand R <;> simp [hx]
+    _ = ∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2 := by
+      change (∫ x : ℝ, (Ioo (-R) R).indicator (fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) x) = _
+      rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Ioo]
+      rfl
+/- The missing negative layer is now proved from the whole band profile.  The
+   density measure packages the actual Fourier square mass, so the layer-cake
+   tails are the genuine band masses rather than a scalar surrogate. -/
+theorem nonnegative_layer_cake_bound
+    {f : ℝ → ℂ} {S m A : ℝ}
+    (hA : 0 < A) (hS : 0 < S) (hm : 0 < m)
+    (hAeq : A = S / (32 * m))
+    (hMassInt : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume)
+    (hMass : (∫ x : ℝ, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) = S)
+    (hProfile : ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R →
+      (∫ x : ℝ in cyclesBand R, ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤
+        4 * Real.sqrt (2 * R * m / S) * S) :
+    Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
+      max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) volume ∧
+      (∫ x : ℝ, max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0 * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * S := by
+  classical
+  let q : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ‖f x‖ ^ 2
+  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => max (Real.log (A / |x|)) 0
+  let qE : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞ := fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (q x)
+  let μ : Measure ℝ := volume.withDensity qE
+  have hq_int : Integrable q volume := by simpa [q] using hMassInt
+  have hq_ae : AEMeasurable q volume := hq_int.aestronglyMeasurable.aemeasurable
+  have hqE_ae : AEMeasurable qE volume := by
+    exact hq_ae.ennreal_ofReal
+  have hmeas : Measurable h := by
+    dsimp [h]
+    fun_prop
+  have hmeas_ae : AEMeasurable h μ := hmeas.aemeasurable
+  have hnonneg : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂μ, 0 ≤ h x :=
+    Eventually.of_forall (fun x => le_max_right _ _)
+  have hlayer :
+      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x) ∂μ) =
+        ∫⁻ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, μ {x : ℝ | t < h x} :=
+    lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt μ hnonneg hmeas_ae
+  have hleft :
+      (∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x * q x)) =
+        ∫⁻ x : ℝ, ENNReal.ofReal (h x) ∂μ := by
+    rw [lintegral_withDensity_eq_lintegral_mul₀ hqE_ae hmeas.aemeasurable.ennreal_ofReal]
+    apply lintegral_congr_ae
+    filter_upwards with x
+    dsimp [qE, q]
+    calc
+      ENNReal.ofReal (h x * ‖f x‖ ^ 2) =
+          ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2 * h x) := by rw [mul_comm]
+      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (‖f x‖ ^ 2) * ENNReal.ofReal (h x) :=
+        ENNReal.ofReal_mul (sq_nonneg _)
+  have htail_bound : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi 0)),

+        ENNReal.ofReal (4 * Real.sqrt (2 * (A * Real.exp (-t)) * m / S) * S) := by
+    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with t ht

+      constructor

+        have hmul : Real.exp t * |x| < A :=
+          (lt_div_iff₀ hxabs).mp hexp
+        have htarget : |x| < A * Real.exp (-t) := by
+          have hdiv : |x| < A / Real.exp t := by
+            exact (lt_div_iff₀ (Real.exp_pos t)).mpr (by simpa [mul_comm] using hmul)

+        simpa [cyclesBand, R, abs_lt] using htarget

+        have htarget : |x| < A * Real.exp (-t) := by

+        have hmul : Real.exp t * |x| < A := by
+          have hdiv : |x| < A / Real.exp t := by

+    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using hexp_int.const_mul C
+  have hC_nonneg_ae : ∀ᵐ t : ℝ ∂(volume.restrict (Ioi 0)),

+    Eventually.of_forall (fun t => mul_nonneg hC_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le)
+  have hC_eval :
+      (∫ t : ℝ in Ioi 0, C * Real.exp ((-1 / 2) * t)) = 2 * C := by
+    rw [integral_const_mul]
+    rw [integral_exp_mul_Ioi (by norm_num : (-1 / 2 : ℝ) < 0) 0]
+    norm_num [mul_comm]
+  have hCA : 2 * C = 2 * S := by
+    dsimp [C]
+    rw [hAeq]
+    have h₁ : 0 ≤ 2 * m / S := by positivity
+    have hprod : Real.sqrt (2 * m / S) * Real.sqrt (S / (32 * m)) =

+
+# The subgraph core conjecture for connected graphs
+
+## Verified locator
+
+Dinesh Pandey and Kamal Lochan Patra, *Some new central parts of connected graphs*,
+arXiv:2110.00738v1, https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.00738v1 and
+https://arxiv.org/pdf/2110.00738v1. The paper's page 1 fixes finite simple
+connected undirected graphs, cut vertices and blocks. Definition 3.23 on page 9
+counts connected subgraphs containing a vertex, and Conjecture 3.25 on page 9
+states that the subgraph core is contained in a block.
+
+## Native statement
+
+For a graph G, f_G(v) is the number of actual connected subgraphs containing v,
+with each subgraph retaining its vertex and edge choices. The subgraph core is
+the set of vertices maximizing f_G. A block is a maximal connected subgraph
+without a cut vertex under the native subgraph convention. The formal result
+keeps singleton graphs, bridge edges, empty deletion, and every finite order;
+it adds no cutoff and does not replace the count by induced or spanning
+subgraphs.
+
+## Formal resolution
+
+`D5/S3/Combinatorics/Graph/Eccentric/SubgraphCoreBlock.result` proves the exact
+whole statement. Its proof uses the existing De–Patra connected-subgraph
+counting interfaces, an attachment injection for subgraphs omitting a root,
+an exact one-root gluing inequality, and the path hull of all maximizers.
+`SubgraphCoreHull.exists_no_cut_cover` is a consumed helper for that proof and
+is not a second external problem or a separate resolution claim.
+
+The result is a repository formalization of this one cited conjecture. It makes
+no priority, originality, worldwide-openness, or empirical claim. The public
+Reg escape audits for the two new declarations remain unfinished under the
+precise linked-issue exception recorded at
+https://github.com/the-omega-institute/trureturing/issues/23700#issuecomment-6499492075;
+that exception is not registration evidence.

+
+$$
+\sum_{n\ge2}u_n=1,
+\qquad
+\sum_{n\ge2}n u_n<\infty,
+\qquad
+f_a(n)=u_n\frac{\eta_{a+n}}{\eta_a},
+\qquad
+\eta_a=\sum_{n\ge2}u_n\eta_{a+n},
+\tag{34.1}
+$$
+
+其中下标模 $m$，则
+
+$$
+d(P)<c_\star.
+\tag{34.2}
+$$
+
+证明。反设 $d(P)=c_\star$。令 $M=\max_a\eta_a$，并取 $a_0$ 使 $\eta_{a_0}=M$。由（34.1），$\eta_{a_0}$ 是相位值的正权凸平均。对每个 $b\in E$，都有某个 $n\ge2$ 满足 $a_0+n=b$，且该项的权重 $u_n$ 严格为正。若存在 $b$ 使 $\eta_b<M$，这个凸平均便严格小于 $M$，矛盾。因此所有 $\eta_a$ 相同，且

+$$
+f_a(n)=u_n\qquad(a\in E,\ n\ge2).
+\tag{34.3}
+$$
+
+若 $m=1$，间隙行是有限均值的严格正 iid 间隙律，定理 4.3 直接给出 $d(P)<c_\star$。以下设 $m\ge2$。由（34.3），相位转移矩阵为
+
+$$
+K(a,b)=\sum_{\substack{n\ge2\\a+n=b}}u_n.
+\tag{34.4}
+$$

+T_x(m)=\frac{E(m)-V}{\sqrt\delta}.
+\tag{121.8}
+$$

+空组补零。给定 $\sigma>0$，令

+\lambda_y(m)=\frac{(T_x(m)-y)^2}{2\sigma^2},\quad
+P_x^y(m)=\frac{P_x(m)e^{-\lambda_y(m)}}
+ {\sum_uP_x(u)e^{-\lambda_y(u)}},\quad
+C3_x(y)=\mathbb E_{P_x^y}
+ \left[-\log P_x^y-\mathbb E_{P_x^y}(-\log P_x^y)\right]^3.
+\tag{121.9}
